content_note: Every rule here is intent-only: a name, an id and a logic line that names the detections the rule would join. There is no query, schedule, severity or alert mapping, so nothing in this file can be imported into a tenant as-is. Author the rule in the XSIAM console from the logic line.

rules.logic: ABIOC(NDR-009 DNS Query-Volume Flood Deviating from Learned Host Baseline) AND ABIOC(NDR-009 High-Entropy Subdomain Labels Deviating from Learned DNS Baseline) — fuses the two auto-tuned behavioral deviations from the same source host into a single DNS-tunnel-exfiltration incident anchored to the host + base-domain causality chain.
rules.name: DNS-Tunnel Exfiltration on a Host — ABIOC Causality Stitch
